Title: Types of Hydroponic Systems: DWC, NFT, Drip & 5 More
Description: Eight hydroponic system types: wick, Kratky, DWC, NFT, ebb and flow, drip, aeroponics, towers. NFT slopes 1–2% at 1–2 L/min; DWC needs 7–10 ppm oxygen. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: hydroponic system types, hydroponics, indoor gardening, hydroponic system
